title: what is a computer?
subtitle: Computer is a things to calculate and fo any other works
detail: A computer is a machine that can be programmed to carry out sequences of arithmetic or logical operations automatically. Modern computers can perform a wide range of tasks, from simple calculations to complex simulations and data processing.

title: what is Flutter?
subtitle: Flutter is an open-source UI software development toolkit created by Google.
detail: Flutter is an open-source UI software development toolkit created by Google. It is used to develop cross platform applications for Android, iOS, Linux, Mac, Windows, Google Fuchsia, and the web from a single codebase.

title: what is Dart?
subtitle: Dart is a programming language designed for client development, such as for the web and mobile apps.
detail: Dart is a programming language designed for client development, such as for the web and mobile apps.
